statement.excerpt: I need everybody to realize that the overbuild has real consequences, and that there’s no post-bubble economy to replace this one, because it’ll be just as expensive to run these things in 2030 as it is today.

from_speaker: just as expensive to run these things

our_interpretation: Today means July 22, 2026. The comparison concerns comparable AI data centers operating in 2030.
The plain reading is that operating comparable capacity will remain roughly as costly in nominal money, leaving no economically viable successor use after the predicted bubble.
Compare operating costs at similar utilization, location and service requirements. Construction costs, GPU purchase prices and electricity consumption alone do not measure total operating costs.
The statement predicts a collapse and its consequences; it does not expressly make the cost forecast conditional on a collapse.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable operating records show that 2030 running costs remain approximately at July 2026 levels, and post-collapse operating results establish the claimed absence of a viable successor business.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative comparable facilities operate materially more cheaply in 2030, or sustained profitable successor uses establish that the predicted economic conclusion failed.
